context: Tests whether the agent prepares Obsidian notes for an existing Quartz site by copying them into content and cleaning what would not work when published.

checklist.name: Copies notes with structure kept
checklist.description: The notes from vault/ are copied into site/content/ with their subdirectory structure intact, and the originals are not modified or removed.

checklist.name: Removes the absolute path
checklist.description: No published note under site/content/ still contains an absolute local path such as /Users/.

checklist.name: Adds body link for frontmatter wiki-link
checklist.description: The note whose frontmatter field holds a wiki-link now also links to that target in the page body, because frontmatter wiki-links are not rendered.

checklist.name: Flags the missing-file reference
checklist.description: The agent tells the user that a sentence points to a file that is not being published, naming the note and the missing file.

checklist.name: Generates a titled index
checklist.description: site/content/index.md exists, has a title in its frontmatter, and links to the included notes.
